caption: The drawing depicts two carved wooden sticks, each with a human head sculpted at the top. The wood is a reddish-brown color with lighter, yellowish-brown highlights showing the carved facial features. The heads are exaggerated in form, with elongated noses, prominent brows, and pronounced chins and cheekbones. The left stick shows the head in a three-quarter view facing right, while the right stick presents the head in profile facing left. Both sticks have natural woody protrusions below the faces, and the texture of the wood is smooth but shows some natural knots. In the upper right corner, there is a small inset sketch of the object with markings and the number 37. The drawing is bordered by a thin, double red line, and there are inscriptions and signatures on the lower margin outside the border, including the names Edw. L. Lopez and London Salon. The background is a plain, off-white color.
title: Walking Stick
